body:
## Problem

v0.77.0 added token controls beyond request count, but the human admin surfaces expose only a subset.

Live Chakra UI claim/issue form contains:

- label
- TTL hours
- request cap
- account pin

It has no fields for `max_tokens` or `rate_limit_per_minute`, although the token HTTP/CLI API supports both and the token table/status documentation treats them as important blast-radius controls.

The documented Telegram/VK command is `/issue <label> [ttl_hours] [max_requests]`; it likewise cannot set token spend or per-minute limits, nor edit/rotate an issued AI token while preserving all controls.

## Expected behavior

- Web, Telegram and VK provide equivalent management for every supported token constraint: label, TTL/expiry, max requests, max actual tokens, requests per minute, scope/role where allowed, and account pin.
- List/show displays every constraint, current usage, provider/account attribution, expiry and revoked state.
- Rotate/reissue preserves constraints by default and permits explicit changes; old token is atomically revoked.
- Validation and bounds are shared with CLI/HTTP rather than reimplemented inconsistently.
- Chat commands remain usable in private messages (a guided multi-step flow is acceptable instead of an unreadable positional command).
- Add cross-surface tests proving a token issued in each admin surface is enforced identically on all model protocols and remains correct after restart.
title: Expose full token budgets and account controls in web, Telegram, and VK admin surfaces
